newsitem.title: GERMANY: Alcatel SEL still to close Mannheim works.
newsitem.headline: Alcatel SEL still to close Mannheim works.

text.p: Electronics manufacturer Alcatel SEL still aims to close its Mannheim plant, which employs about 400 workers, chief executive Roland Mecklinger said.

After a meeting late on Monday with Baden Wuerttemberg premier Erwin Teufel, Mecklinger said if Alcatel SEL does not achieve a turnaround this year, the entire company's existence could be threatened.
Alcatel SEL is the German unit of France's Alcatel Alsthom.
Teufel said he still wants the company to abide by a 1995 agreement in which it promised to maintain at least 410 jobs at the Mannheim plant, which has been on the brink of closure for years.
Last night's talks made little progress, but both sides said further rounds are planned.
Teufel said he sees the 1995 pact as a contractual commitment by the company, but Mecklinger said the company's lawyers do not view it that way.
Mecklinger said the Mannheim plant's defence and navigation systems production would be moved to Pforzheim and Stuttgart, but that many of the jobs would be eliminated.
